name: tweet-card
title: Tweet Card
description: A social-post card showing a single post: the author's picture and name with a verified tick, the handle, the message text and any attached photo, linking out to the original.
use: A page wants social proof from a real public post shown without an iframe.
avoid: No server access: the full card fetches the post from X and needs a server or API route.
a11y: Links are keyboard reachable, images carry alt text and the outbound link has a screen-reader label. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark card with a thin border, topped by a small round avatar, the name "Kelly King" beside a blue check and the handle beneath. Two lines of white text sit above a large red-and-blue abstract image.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The author name, handle and bird icon are links that open the profile or post in a new tab.
customise: Pass a post object with its text, author, counts and media; layout and colours come from classes and design tokens.
weight: light: One card of text and a single image; no animation or chart loop.
demo: A sample post by Kelly King about shipping 1,500 components, with a red-and-blue abstract photo.
polishWhy: Faithful, tidy post layout; the swirling demo image clashes with the neutral card.
